adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::GroupsController#add_members`, the code `usernames.split(",").each` only adds when `User.find_by_username(username)` returns a user, otherwise it does nothing and still renders `success_json` if `group.save` succeeds. It also does not `strip` per-username tokens, so whitespace-padded entries would be skipped. However, the diff shows similar prior behavior existed (the removed spec cases explicitly asserted silent success for non-existent users), so this is more an API/UX semantics concern than a clear defect introduced by the change.
